notes.title: Gravitura 1.1 Released
notes.content:
[b]Gravitura 1.1[/b]
[list]
[*]Mouse cursor is now constrained to the window in full screen mode to prevent the game from loosing focus while you're playing, this is especially good if you're using multiple monitors.
[*]Added some hints to some of the earlier levels, to help new players learn the game a little faster.
[/list]

Many thanks to [b]Brian Rubin[/b] for providing the feedback that went into this update. Also this may be the last update to Gravitura in a while, as I'm fully [b]focused on Advanced Mechanized Spacecraft[/b] now.

Cheers,
  - ChAdams

notes.title: Gravitura 1.09 - Controller Support, Mouse emulation with keyboard, Faster level restart
notes.content:
[h1]Gravitura 1.09[/h1]

[list]
 [*] Play with a Gamepad (analog + 5 buttons or d-pad + buttons)
 [*] Gamepad configuration wizard to allow you to setup your gamepad how you like
 [*] Can use the arrow keys & Z (left click) & X (right click) to emulate the mouse, in-game the arrows keys work like the d-pad to let you to orient your ship, and you can use Z & X to thrust forward)
 [*] When you die, or hit the quick restart button, the restart animation is much faster.
[/list]

We'll wait for user feedback and then release 1.1 with any fixes, adjustments that are required.

Enjoy!
